title_zh: Explorations and exchanges — 第42节可背诵讲义
body_en: Online exchanges need safety rules. Never share your home address or secret numbers. Use school email when your teacher asks. After a talk, write three new facts you learned about the other culture. Real friendship grows from care and honesty.
body_zh: 线上交流需要安全规则。绝不分享家庭住址或秘密号码。老师要求时使用学校邮箱。交流后写下你学到的关于另一种文化的三个新事实。真正的友谊来自关心与诚实。
